chapter: Las Vegas, Sinatra and later years
title: Time off was not enough; realizing how he loves to play
summary: Fishing and travel left something missing; at Caesar's he discovered he truly enjoyed playing.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah, well that was - that was good so for those two years you just moved around. You went to Hawaii, you --
Yeah, I went around. I used to go fishing and do all the things you think when you're working hard you'd like to do.
But after you've done them, what have you got, there's still something missing.
It was something and I didn't know what it was, so when I started to play at Caesar's there, I started playing -- yeah, this is right.
I mean -- even apart from being a musician if you've worked all your life you feel that living is working. And if you're a musician --
I suddenly realized I really enjoyed this playing. I really enjoy it now.
